title: Measure build cache and disk (A1); accept D145
summary: Docs job for audience Sri and the verifier: run sccache --show-stats in a build, measure hits across two worktrees with different target dirs, measure T and S, record the numbers in docs/decisions.md, mark D145 accepted by the brain under Sri's delegation (2026-10-29), add a CHANGELOG entry. No drain behavior changes; max_in_flight = 1 is today's drain.

defaults_applied.how: Measurements in decisions.md cite the commands run and label estimates.
Verifier runs fmt, clippy and tests and reads the diff.
Criteria check the recorded numbers and cause, not the activity.
No paths with personal data or secrets are recorded.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: give the async drain design measured numbers for build cache and disk; audience is Sri and the verifier of later build jobs.

Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs (df_free_bytes, sweep_idle_targets, hold functions); it is context for disk measurement and is not expected to change, since the request is measurement and recording only and adds no drain behavior.

If the producer cannot run sccache (not installed or unavailable), it records that fact and the command output as the measurement instead of inventing numbers; unmeasured values are labeled estimates.
The D145 heading in docs/decisions.md (currently '(proposed)') becomes accepted, with the decider and the date 2026-10-29; docs/design/async-drain.md status line may be updated to match.
No athena.toml change and no governance file change; there are no new behaviors, so the existing drain tests are untouched and must pass unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/decisions.md contains a measurements entry for A1 that states the sccache --show-stats output or the reason it could not run, the cause found for D84's 0 hits (or an explicit statement that it was not found), the hit counts across two worktrees with different target directories, and numeric values for T (one cold target/) and S (worktree source size) with units and the commands used.
The D145 heading in docs/decisions.md no longer says proposed and states accepted, decided by the brain under Sri's delegation, 2026-10-29.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry naming the A1 measurements and D145 acceptance.
git diff shows no change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or any file under .github/workflows/.
Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test: all pass, including the existing drain tests unchanged (max_in_flight = 1 behaves as today).

out_of_scope: Any athena.toml change or re-enabling sccache
Implementing read-ahead, per-job worktrees or max_in_flight
Changing drain behavior or existing drain tests
departures: Measurement needs running sccache and builds, which the producer may only partly be able to do; this adds some risk of a verifier mismatch.
